task.title: Make the shell's own view heads part of the window's drag band
task.description: With PR for the title row (feat/title-row, 2026-10-08) the board's header and the sidebar head are the window's drag targets. On the shell's own views, import and Next, nothing across the top of the main column drags the window: the title strip that used to cover it was removed and those views' .view-head rows are not marked. Mark the view head (or a band the height of the title row, TITLE_ROW_HEIGHT in layout.js) as -webkit-app-region: drag on those views, with the search box, buttons and inputs inside it opted out, so the whole top row drags on every view. Pin it in desktop/test/drag-region.test.js the way the sidebar head is. Also record a hands-on Windows check of the board header's overlay clearance: Electron 44.2.0 passes no env(titlebar-area-*) to a WebContentsView, so the header uses a fixed 138px fallback that nobody has seen on a Windows machine.
